history.label: 第 2 輪：做扎實與供應鏈
第 3 輪：不需等 Q2 的全部

kind_legend.accounting: A bookkeeping rule. Upgrades straight to verified by a controlled experiment; literature does not apply.
kind_legend.behaviour: A causal response (a lever moves demand, retention ...). Heuristic behaviour is the riskiest: it can be mistaken for real cause and effect.
kind_legend.information: Buys or shows information; changes no number of the quarter.
kind_legend.qualitative: Text or planning decisions; no known numeric effect.
kind_legend.scenario: An assumption the player chooses (rival behaviour). Results are conditional on it.

maturity_legend.heuristic: Practice rule from general business sense; no literature, no calibration. Lowest rung. Placeholder accounting rules (structure from game parameters, combination unverified) are heuristic too.
maturity_legend.literature: Functional form backed by published literature; coefficients not calibrated on this game.
maturity_legend.not-modeled: The real game has it; this engine does not.
maturity_legend.verified: Captured from the game and reproduced (or fitted on game data and passed hold-out validation).

modules.name: 需求核心（區隔選擇與外部選項）
modules.next_step: To verified: fit the coefficients on Q2+ demand panels (FittedDemand) and pass hold-out validation (MAPE <= 20 %, direction hit rate >= 70 %).
modules.ours: LiteratureDemand: multinomial-logit / MCI attraction with an outside option (src/marketplace_sim/demand.py).
modules.real_note: Sales and market share are reported every quarter; the game's demand formula itself is not observable.

modules.name: 目標區隔選擇
modules.next_step: To verified: calibrate similarity_power and fit_weight on Q2+ brand-by-segment sales.
modules.ours: Each brand targets a segment; fit to other segments falls with need similarity (demand chain).
modules.real_note: Target Segments is a decision screen in the captured Q1 menu.

modules.name: 品牌設計（類型與元件）
modules.next_step: To verified: relate brand-judgment scores to sales once Q2 reports are captured; fit the quality term.
modules.ours: Brand type and components chosen per brand; fit enters the demand chain; component choice also drives the (heuristic) unit cost.
modules.real_note: Design Brand is a decision screen in the captured Q1 menu.

modules.name: 產品線（多品牌與相互侵蝕）
modules.next_step: To verified: check cannibalisation against Q2+ brand-level sales.
modules.ours: Several brands per firm; they compete for the same buyers inside the logit (cannibalisation).
modules.real_note: Several brands can be designed on the Q1 brand screen.

modules.name: 定價
modules.next_step: To verified: fit price_sensitivity on Q2+ price and sales variation.
modules.ours: Price relative to willingness to pay enters the utility (price_sensitivity).
modules.real_note: A Pricing screen is registered but was not in the Q1 menu; public teaching sources list pricing.

modules.name: 促銷（回饋金、贈品、店頭陳列）
modules.next_step: To literature: a published perceived value of a rebate at purchase (none found; only choice shares from one experiment). Add gifts and display as further parts. To verified: Q2+ Promotions screen and the rebates row.
modules.ours: PromotionsModule: a per-unit rebate lowers the price the customer weighs (perceived share of the rebate, heuristic), so the demand chain's price response decides volume; rebates are paid on redeemed units at a rate inside the published field range (7-50 %, default 27 %). Free gifts and point-of-purchase display are not modelled.
modules.real_note: Rebate and point-of-purchase fields on Pricing; a Promotions screen is registered.

ui.practice: 回饋金讓顧客感受到的價格變低（用需求面的價格反應）；只有一部分買家會真的去兌換。兌換率在文獻報告的實地範圍內（7–50%，預設 27%），但顧客把回饋金當幾成的「感受比例」沒有文獻數字，是暫定值，所以整個模組仍是練習。

modules.name: 廣告預算與累積效果
modules.next_step: To verified: fit ad_elasticity and carryover on Q2+ data; keep the literature ranges as priors.
modules.ours: Goodwill stock with carryover; power or ADBUDG response with diminishing returns (demand chain).
modules.real_note: Media and ad screens are registered; public teaching sources describe advertising decisions.

modules.name: 廣告媒體分配
modules.next_step: To verified: estimate the media weights w_m (and test a cross-media synergy term, Naik & Raman 2003) on Q2+ media-level spend and sales; pass hold-out validation. Still uncalibrated: the weights (neutral equal default; no published general ranking of these media).
modules.ours: MediaMixLiterature: per-medium MCI advertising terms; the demand chain's own elasticity is split across media by weights w_m (sum 1). The best split is s_m = w_m, which reproduces the single literature response; any other split loses part of it.
modules.real_note: Local, regional, social and search media screens are registered; public sources describe media selection.

modules.name: 廣告訊息與文案
modules.next_step: To literature: full text of Dall'Olio & Vakratsas 2023 (creative strategy and advertising elasticity; abstract has no numbers). To verified: the game's ad-copy screen from Q2+.
modules.ours: AdCopyModule: the message stresses the target segment's 1st/2nd/3rd need; attraction moves by at most a labelled lift in proportion to that need against the segment's mean need (only with advertising).
modules.real_note: Ad design screen and ad judgment report are registered; public sources mention ad copy and appeals.

ui.practice: 廣告強調目標客群重視的需求會加分、強調不重視的會扣分（最多 ± 暫定幅度）；只有方向有文獻支持。

modules.name: 網路行銷（網頁、流量、社群）
modules.next_step: To verified: the game's web marketing screens and their effect on web sales from Q2+ (fit the elasticity inside the range).
modules.ours: InternetMarketingModule: constant-elasticity response with the elasticity in [0.003, 0.23] (bias-corrected advertising meta-analysis to the online display estimate; default 0.05), applied in proportion to the web share of our outlets (labelled mapping); spending line heuristic.
modules.real_note: Web page, traffic and productivity screens are registered.

ui.literature: 固定彈性、報酬遞減；彈性限定在文獻範圍 0.003–0.23（廣告彈性後設分析到網路展示廣告的估計），預設 0.05。只對網路中心帶來的那部分市場有效（依網路中心占據點的比例，標明的對應假設）。
ui.practice: 網路行銷支出怎麼入帳（遊戲規則）未觀察到，支出列是練習。

modules.name: 市場調查購買
modules.next_step: To verified: the game's report list and prices once the market-research screen opens.
modules.ours: MarketResearchModule: segment and rival reports at a labelled price; their content is this engine's own estimate at its level.
modules.real_note: Market research purchase screens are registered; public sources list a research budget.

ui.practice: 報告內容是本引擎自己的估計（等級跟需求鏈一樣，不會更可信）；報告價格是暫定值。

modules.name: 開店（設立成本）
modules.next_step: Keep: re-run EXP-11 if the screen changes in a later quarter.
modules.ours: Opening cost = setup cost of newly opened stores (cost_model).
modules.real_note: Open Stores is a decision screen in Q1; opening cost reproduced by EXP-11.

modules.name: 網路銷售中心（設立成本）
modules.next_step: Keep: re-run EXP-12 if the screen changes.
modules.ours: Opening cost = setup cost of newly opened web centers.
modules.real_note: Open Web Sales Center is a decision screen in Q1; opening cost reproduced by EXP-12. Not found in public descriptions.

modules.name: 通路覆蓋對需求的效果
modules.next_step: To verified: fit distribution_elasticity and web_weight on Q2+ city-level sales.
modules.ours: Coverage = 1 - (1 - store)(1 - web weight x web), raised to the distribution elasticity.
modules.real_note: A channel demand report is registered; the effect of an open outlet on demand is not observable in Q1.

modules.name: 通路租金
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: needs the game's charge in the quarter after an opening. Read the Q2 statement after a Q1 opening; reproduce the lease row with zero residual.
modules.ours: Placeholder: lease of outlets open at quarter start. Verified branch: nothing open at quarter start means no lease (EXP-11/12 measured no lease in the opening quarter).
modules.real_note: Lease cost is a field on the Q1 outlet screens; when it is charged was not observed (EXP-11/12 showed none in the opening quarter).

modules.name: 業務編制與招募
modules.next_step: To verified: fit the elasticity and the reference scale on Q2+ sales by quarter and headcount; the game's hiring cost rule needs the HireSalesPeople calculate (awaiting Q2 capture).
modules.ours: SalesForceModule: selling effort = (1 + force per market / reference)^elasticity, the elasticity inside the meta-analytic range; multiplies the attraction of our offers. Hiring cost lines stay heuristic.
modules.real_note: Hire Sales People is registered but not in the Q1 menu; public sources list the number of salespeople employed.

modules.name: 業務薪酬、佣金與留任
modules.next_step: To literature: a published base quit rate for comparable sales jobs and a pay-index definition. To verified: Q2+ headcount after pay changes.
modules.ours: SalesForceModule (heuristic part): quit rate = base x pay index^(-elasticity), elasticity in the published separation range 0.4-2.0 (default 0.75); the base quit rate and the commission weight are practice defaults.
modules.real_note: Industry Sales Force Compensation is a report in the Q1 menu (measured); the decision screen (SalesForceCompensation) is registered but not seen.

modules.name: 業務訓練
modules.next_step: To literature: a published dose-response or decay of sales training (Arthur et al. 1998 skill-decay review is a candidate, not yet verified). To verified: observe the SpecialPrograms effect from Q2 on.
modules.ours: SalesForceModule (heuristic part): training builds a decaying skill stock; the full-skill gain is bounded by the literature (d x SDp = 0.231-0.301), the dose and decay are practice rules; any skill makes the demand chain heuristic.
modules.real_note: Special Programs (training, demo kit, contest) is registered; public sources list training.

modules.name: 網路業務人員
modules.next_step: To literature: an elasticity for web or phone selling (none found). To verified: HireWebSalesPeople from Q2+.
modules.ours: SalesForceModule (heuristic part): web salespeople add a constant-elasticity response weighted by the web share of our outlets; paid the field salary.
modules.real_note: Hire Web Sales People is registered; demand projection screens have per-web-salesperson fields.

fields.label: 工資水準（1 = 當地行情）
fields.name: wage_index

modules.name: 生產工人薪酬與生產力
modules.next_step: To literature: a verified wage elasticity of production (Krassoi Peach & Stanley 2009 meta-analysis: abstract only, value not verified). To verified: worker screens from Q2+.
modules.ours: ProductionWorkersModule: wage index scales direct labour and, bounded, worker productivity (capacity).
modules.real_note: Industry Production Worker Compensation is a Q1 report; worker compensation and productivity screens are registered.

ui.practice: 工資高於行情：直接人工成本變高，但留任與努力提高、產能略增（效率工資）；生產力彈性沒有可用的文獻數字，是暫定值。

modules.name: 主管薪酬、員工參與與人資調查
modules.next_step: To literature: the corrected engagement correlations of Harter, Schmidt & Hayes 2002 (full text not reachable; abstract has no numbers) and a causal reading of them. To verified: Q3+ screens.
modules.ours: CultureModule: participation spend and an executive bonus pool build a morale stock that raises capacity a little; morale shown only with an employee survey.
modules.real_note: Executive compensation, employee involvement and HR survey screens are registered.

ui.practice: 參與方案與主管獎金累積成「士氣」，士氣讓產能略增；士氣只有買員工調查才看得到。只有方向有文獻支持（參與與生產力的後設分析），幅度是暫定值。

modules.name: 固定產能投資
modules.next_step: Keep.
modules.ours: Capacity option cost; capacity per quarter = units/day x days per quarter; usable next quarter.
modules.real_note: Fixed Capacity is a Q1 decision screen; capacity cost reproduced by EXP-02.

modules.name: 單位生產成本
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: needs the game's cost of production for a known brand and volume (Q2 cost-of-production report or the FactorySimulation calculate).
modules.ours: Placeholder: sum(component price) x cost adjustment + minimum labour + minimum overhead (ignores learning curve, scale and variable terms). Verified branch: nothing produced costs nothing. Material part can be scaled by the purchasing module.
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 brand screen lists component prices and cost adjustment, but also learning-curve, scale-threshold, variable labour and overhead, and inefficiency parameters; the combination is unobserved.

modules.name: 設計與開線費
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: when and where the game charges design cost (R&D row or production) is unobserved. Match the Q2 statements after designing one brand in Q1.
modules.ours: Placeholder: design cost per new brand. Verified branch: no new brand designed means no design cost (structural zero).
modules.real_note: Design and setup cost are Q1 brand-screen parameters; when they are charged is unverified.

modules.name: 學習曲線
modules.next_step: To verified: compare unit costs across Q2+ quarters with known cumulative volume and fit the game's parameter.
modules.ours: LearningCurveModule (model option): Wright learning curve, Stanford-B form, on labour + overhead per brand; progress ratio in the published centre (80-82 %); experience counted from switch-on.
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 brand screen carries a learning-curve parameter (structure only); how the game applies it is unverified.

ui.literature: 累積產量每加倍，人工與製造費用降到「進步率」倍（Wright 1936；進步率在文獻分布中心 80–82%）。經驗從開啟這個選項的那一季開始累計；單位成本本身仍是佔位規則，所以成本仍標 ≈。
ui.toggle: 納入學習曲線（模型選項）

modules.name: 營運產能：班別
modules.next_step: To literature: a verified relative output of later shifts (only accident risk found). To verified: the game's shift rules from Q2+.
modules.ours: OperatingCapacityModule (heuristic part): extra shifts multiply capacity, later shifts less efficient, fixed cost per shift.
modules.real_note: Operating capacity and overtime screens are registered.

ui.literature: 加班的產能反應用文獻的工時–產出關係：每週 49 小時以下產出與工時成正比，超過後彈性只剩約 0.17（Pencavel 2015）；以每週 40 小時為正常工時（標明的假設）。
ui.practice: 多開一班產能變多但效率較低、每班有固定費用（後班效率沒有文獻數字）；加班工資按 1.5 倍（美國法定下限，遊戲規則未觀察到），所以成本是練習。

modules.name: 加班
modules.next_step: To verified: the game's overtime capacity and cost from Q2+ (fit the elasticities inside the range).
modules.ours: OperatingCapacityModule (literature part): overtime capacity from the piecewise log-log output-hours relation (elasticity ~1 below 49 hours a week, 0.17 above; Pencavel 2015) on a labelled 40-hour week; the 1.5 x premium (statutory floor) makes the cost heuristic.
modules.real_note: Operating capacity and overtime screens are registered.

ui.literature: 加班的產能反應用文獻的工時–產出關係：每週 49 小時以下產出與工時成正比，超過後彈性只剩約 0.17（Pencavel 2015）；以每週 40 小時為正常工時（標明的假設）。
ui.practice: 多開一班產能變多但效率較低、每班有固定費用（後班效率沒有文獻數字）；加班工資按 1.5 倍（美國法定下限，遊戲規則未觀察到），所以成本是練習。

modules.name: 閒置產能成本
modules.next_step: To verified (accounting): read the row on a Q2 statement with known capacity and production, and reproduce it.
modules.ours: ExcessCapacityModule (model option): unused capacity units x a labelled idle cost per unit.
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 income statement has an 'excess capacity' expense row (structure only; how it is computed is not observed).

ui.practice: 遊戲損益表有「閒置產能」費用列（Q1 擷取的結構），但怎麼算沒看到；這裡用「沒用到的產能 × 暫定單位成本」。
ui.toggle: 計入閒置產能成本（模型選項）

modules.name: 生產規則與排程
modules.next_step: Add changeover loss per brand produced; to verified: production-rule screens from Q3+.
modules.ours: ProductionPlanningModule (heuristic part): brands get capacity in the player's priority order when it binds. Changeover losses are not modelled.
modules.real_note: Production rules, control system and changeover screens are registered; scheduling is common to business games.

ui.literature: 「補到目標庫存」用文獻的訂購點形式：平均需求 × 目標季數 + z × 標準差 × √季數，減掉期初庫存；需求紀錄來自本引擎自己的估計，所以生產量跟需求鏈同等級（≈）。第一季還沒有紀錄時用計畫量。
ui.practice: 產能不夠時按優先順序分配；遊戲的分配規則未觀察到。

modules.name: 品質、檢驗與重工
modules.next_step: To literature: no published sales or share elasticity to defect rate found (Tellis & Johnson 2007 is about stock returns; review valence 0.417 is perceived, not objective, quality). To verified: quality screens from Q3+.
modules.ours: QualityModule: QA spend per unit lowers the defect rate; defects lower attraction and cost warranty repairs.
modules.real_note: Inspection, rework and corrective-action screens and quality-cost reports are registered; public sources mention product quality.

ui.practice: 每件品管投入降低不良率；不良品降低吸引力並產生保固維修費。只有方向有文獻支持（PIMS），幅度是暫定值。開啟這個模組但不投入時，不良率按基準值計算。

modules.name: 工廠與倉庫地點
modules.next_step: To verified: the game's site options and costs from Q3+.
modules.ours: FactoryLocationModule: a lower-wage site scales direct labour and adds shipping per unit; a move costs a one-off charge.
modules.real_note: Factory and warehouse location screens are registered; public sources mention plant location.

ui.practice: 低工資地區：直接人工較便宜，但每件要多付運費；搬遷要付一次搬遷費。數字都是暫定值。

modules.name: 庫存持有成本
modules.next_step: To verified: read the game's holding or inventory-tax charge on a Q2+ statement with known ending inventory; reproduce it.
modules.ours: InventoryModule: annual carrying-cost rate (inside the published range) / 4 x value of units left at quarter end (unit cost). Placeholder downstream while unit cost is a placeholder.
modules.real_note: An inventory tax parameter is on the captured Q1 statement view and inventory screens are registered; how the game charges holding cost is not observed.

modules.name: 庫存出清
modules.next_step: To verified: observe the game's sell-off price on SellUnwantedInventory once it opens; no general published salvage rate applies, so no literature step.
modules.ours: InventoryModule (heuristic part): units sold off at quarter start bring a labelled salvage fraction of unit cost.
modules.real_note: A SellUnwantedInventory screen is registered (field sellInventory).

modules.next_step: To verified: the game's InventoryControl rule (max ending inventory, produce) from Q2+.
modules.ours: ProductionPlanningModule (literature part): order-up-to rule, production = max(mean x cover + z x sd x sqrt(cover) - inventory, 0) from this engine's own record of units demanded; at the record's level (≈ at best).
modules.real_note: InventoryControl (maxEndingInventory, produce) and TargetReplenishPoint screens are registered.

modules.name: 採購、供應商與合約
modules.next_step: To literature: only if a published range of component volume discounts is found (none so far; Dolan 1987 and Monahan 1984 give the form, not magnitudes). To verified: observe supplier terms (ConfirmRFP) once the screens open.
modules.ours: PurchasingHeuristic: a quarterly component volume contract earns an all-units discount on the material part of unit cost for the units produced under it; unproduced contract units pay a fee. New production coupling: material cost factor.
modules.real_note: Supply-chain strategy, information system, contract and partner-payment screens are registered; the captured Q1 brand screen lists component and scale thresholds, and the capacity screen a supplier field.

modules.name: 前置期與供應中斷
modules.next_step: Kept not-modeled on purpose: no evidence the game has lead times or disruptions; capture first (ledger rule for 'unknown').
modules.ours: None. The control plane can apply shocks as scenario events (capacity factor), which is a stress test, not a model.
modules.real_note: Risk and cost-trend screens are registered; no lead-time field has been seen.

modules.name: 研發新功能
modules.next_step: Model the game's project cost and availability delay once FeatureRD is captured (Q2+); to verified then.
modules.ours: RnDModule: R&D stock by perpetual inventory (15 %/year), attraction elasticity in the published R&D range (a labelled mapping from output to attraction). Spending line heuristic. Feature availability after a delay is not modelled.
modules.real_note: Feature R&D screens are registered; Q1 component data carry an appearance quarter and a project cost.

ui.literature: 研發累積成「研發存量」（每年折舊 15%，Griliches 慣例），吸引力依文獻範圍內的研發彈性（0.01–0.25）報酬遞減地提高；把產出彈性當成吸引力彈性是標明的對應假設。
ui.practice: 研發支出怎麼入帳（遊戲規則）未觀察到，支出列是練習。

modules.next_step: Kept not-modeled: nothing tells what triggers a licence or its amount; capture the first quarter where the rows are non-zero.
modules.ours: None.
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 income statement has licensing income and licensing fee rows (structure only); no licensing screen was seen in Q1.

modules.next_step: Keep (the withdraw term was not varied: re-test when convenient).
modules.ours: Balance and interest (cost_model).
modules.real_note: Certificate of Deposit is a Q1 decision screen; reproduced by EXP-01.

modules.next_step: Keep.

modules.real_note: Closely Held Stock is in the Q1 menu; the raise is a view identity.

modules.next_step: To verified: read the game's loan terms when the screens open (Q2+) and reproduce a loan's cash rows.

ui.practice: 現金的進出是精確的算術，但利率、期數、上限都是暫定值（遊戲的貸款條件未觀察到）。借款與還本、股利是現金流（不進損益），利息是費用。

modules.name: 緊急貸款
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: the loan rule and its interest (rate fields on the statement view) need a quarter that ends with negative cash (only if it happens naturally; never forced).
modules.ours: Placeholder: covers negative cash, no interest charged. Verified branch: no loan while cash is not negative (captured Q1 statement: no emergency loan at positive cash; a minimum-cash threshold, if any, is unverified).
modules.real_note: An emergency-loan rate field appears on the Q1 pro-forma cash flow; the rule was not observed.

modules.name: 所得稅
modules.next_step: Cannot be verified by arithmetic alone: needs the game's tax on a profitable quarter. First build the accrual income statement and carry-forward (structure measured), then reproduce the tax row of the first profitable settlement.
modules.ours: Placeholder: max(cash-basis pretax, 0) x tax rate. Known incomplete (no carry-forward, no inventory tax, cash basis). Verified branch: no tax on a pre-tax loss with nothing produced or held (structural zero, as certain as the sign of pretax).
modules.real_note: A tax-rate and an inventory-tax field appear on the captured Q1 statement view; the captured income statement has a loss carry-forward row before taxable income, and taxes accrual income. The rule was not observed.

modules.next_step: To verified: the game's dividend rule and limits (Q3+).
modules.ours: FinancingModule (dividends): paid from cash as a financing flow.

ui.practice: 現金的進出是精確的算術，但利率、期數、上限都是暫定值（遊戲的貸款條件未觀察到）。借款與還本、股利是現金流（不進損益），利息是費用。

modules.name: 外匯與多幣別資金
modules.next_step: Kept not-modeled: the pack carries no currency per market and the capture time is unknown; capture the markets' currencies first.
modules.ours: None (one currency).
modules.real_note: Currency fund screen and exchange-rate report are registered (probably international editions only).

modules.name: 創投募資談判
modules.next_step: Kept not-modeled: the game's investor rules are not observed and no published form maps a company's results to an offer; capture first.
modules.ours: Stock issue at a price the player enters.
modules.real_note: Described in public teaching sources (business plan and equity negotiation); no matching decision screen has been identified.

modules.name: 現金流量（現金恆等式）
modules.next_step: Keep. The identity is verified; each row keeps its own level, so ending cash is only shown as verified when every row is. Re-check against a Q2 cash-flow statement with non-zero rows.
modules.ours: Ending cash = beginning cash + revenue + stock raised + CD flow + interest - operating expenses - capacity investment - tax + emergency loan. Identity reproduced with zero residual in every run (tests), and every engine row maps to a statement row with the same sign. Rows the game has and we do not (rebates, R&D, internet marketing, shipping, excess capacity, licensing, other, loans) are listed; in the captured Q1 projection they are all zero.
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 cash-flow statement gives the structure: beginning cash, operating receipts and disbursements, investing, financing, ending cash; every row is added with its sign (measured). Its totals are server-computed.

modules.name: 損益表（應計基礎）
modules.next_step: To verified (accounting): reproduce a Q2 income statement row by row with the accrual option.
modules.ours: Engine default: cash-basis profit (never above placeholder). With the AccrualAccounting option: COGS at moving-average cost, depreciation, inventory tax, tax after a loss carry-forward (heuristic rules).
modules.real_note: The captured Q1 income statement is accrual: cost of goods sold, depreciation, a loss carry-forward row before taxable income, and an inventory tax parameter (structure only; Q1 values are all zero).

ui.practice: 照遊戲報表的結構（銷貨成本、折舊、虧損扣抵、庫存稅）另算一份應計損益表和資產負債表，所得稅改用應計稅前利潤扣掉虧損扣抵後計算。折舊年限、庫存計價、稅率都是暫定值；資產負債表每季都會平衡（有測試）。
results: 資產 − 負債 − 權益
ui.toggle: 用應計基礎記帳（模型選項）

modules.name: 資產負債表
modules.next_step: To verified (accounting): reproduce the Q2 balance sheet row by row (valuation and depreciation rules).
modules.ours: AccrualAccounting (model option): cash, CDs, inventory at book value, plant | loans, emergency loans | stock, retained earnings; balances every quarter (tested). Capacity owned before the option is off the books. Our books also carry inventory and long-term loans, which the captured sheet has no rows for (src/marketplace_sim/reconcile.py BALANCE_EXTRA).
modules.real_note: Pro-forma balance sheet is in the Q1 menu. Captured rows (structure): cash, CD, net fixed assets | short loan, emergency loan | common stock, retained earnings; no inventory row.

ui.practice: 照遊戲報表的結構（銷貨成本、折舊、虧損扣抵、庫存稅）另算一份應計損益表和資產負債表，所得稅改用應計稅前利潤扣掉虧損扣抵後計算。折舊年限、庫存計價、稅率都是暫定值；資產負債表每季都會平衡（有測試）。

modules.name: 對手行為
modules.next_step: To verified: replay captured rival offers (control-plane replay) from Q2 on; bots stay as what-if assumptions.
modules.ours: Bots with fixed rules (BaselineBot, RandomBot, price factors) chosen as opponents; a replay of real rival offers is reserved for the private Q2+ panel. Results are conditional on the chosen rivals.
modules.real_note: Rivals are other teams; competitor reports are registered.

modules.name: 市場潛量成長與季節性
modules.next_step: Kept not-modeled on purpose: whether the game's market grows or has seasons is unknown; capture first (ledger rule for 'unknown').
modules.ours: Constant: quarterly potential = 12-month size / 4 every quarter.
modules.real_note: Q1 market potential is a captured parameter; how it changes over quarters is unknown. An economic-index report is registered.

modules.name: 需求預測與產銷規劃工具
modules.next_step: To verified: the game's projection tool output against our estimate once captured (Q2+).
modules.ours: The preview (calculate) shows the engine's own demand estimate (literature, ≈); the order-up-to rule records it per brand.
modules.real_note: Demand projection and factory simulation screens are registered; public sources describe a demand forecast by brand.

modules.name: 平衡計分卡與排名
modules.next_step: To verified: capture the game's scorecard after a settlement and reproduce its formula.
modules.ours: ScorecardModule (model option): the four Kaplan & Norton perspectives scored 0..1 from this quarter's lines; labelled equal weights. Not the game's ranking.
modules.real_note: Scorecard and standing reports are registered; public sources describe a cumulative balanced scorecard.

ui.practice: 四個構面（財務、顧客、內部流程、學習成長）來自 Kaplan & Norton（1992）；各構面怎麼打分、權重多少都是暫定值，不是遊戲的排名公式。

rules: Structure and maturity only. No game values, no market data, no fitted coefficients.

real_status: measured = seen in the captured Q1 menu or reproduced by an experiment; inferred = a client screen is registered but was not seen in Q1, and/or a public teaching source describes it (unverified until captured); unknown = no evidence either way.
Anything inferred stays 'unverified, awaiting capture' until a later quarter is captured.
Downstream numbers always take the weakest maturity of their inputs.
